    exports_pct_str = centru_row['percent of total exports'].iloc[0]
    imports_pct_str = centru_row['percent of total imports'].iloc[0]
    
    # Remove any spaces and the '%' symbol, then convert to float
    exports_pct = float(str(exports_pct_str).replace(' ', '').replace('%', ''))
